- It stars Volk (the Wolf) and Zayats (the Hare). The Wolf repeatedly tries to catch the Hare and is repeatedly foiled. It is a slapstick chase comedy aimed largely at children and families.
- The series does not have a clear, well-documented focus on mocking Western culture or presenting the USSR as superior. The earlier description overstated its propaganda content. It is better understood as popular Soviet entertainment that may carry some ideological undertones, not as a piece of anti-Western propaganda.
